author: Epic Games
description:
Faraway is a randomly-generated, minimalistic and demanding, arcade-puzzle game about a shooting star that designs constellations to stay alive. With immersive realtime visuals and interactive music, it’s a game of long-term mastery. You can play in quick bites or hours-long sessions, making it the perfect game to revisit for years to come.  Created single-handedly by game designer, creative coder, and musician Steph Thirion, creator of the cult game Eliss, Faraway is an immersive minimalistic game of deep expressive play, made for discovery, replay, and long-term mastery.  

Faraway is coming November 5 to the Epic Games Store. Wishlist now! https://epic.gm/faraway
